title: Mushrooms [full]
description: Collection of optimization mods from Mushrooms
body:
![Mushrooms](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e2518150f0d7854dbc7cba2f4c14f8e458fb1cdc.png)
Сборка модов предназначена для игры на сервере Mushrooms **[Фулл версия]**

Сборка оптимизирует большую часть аспектов игры, а так же добавляет множество удобных функций и фишек в игру. Сборка предназначена для игры на бесплатном приватном сервере в майнкрафт "Mushrooms".
Что бы попасть к нам вступай в наш дискорд и подавай заявку на вступление. 12+

Наш дискорд: https://discord.gg/S6qYYf8htE
![we](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/026309266519a62e8b738b45efd24802bdda71dc_0.webp)
Автор некоторых ресурспаков, использующихся в сборке:
[Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/organization/fabulously-optimized),
[Minimal Armor](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/minimal-armor-countxd/version/2WjguvnV)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
![Mushrooms](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e2518150f0d7854dbc7cba2f4c14f8e458fb1cdc.png)
Collection of mods is designed to play on the Russian server Mushrooms **[Full version]**.

The collection optimizes most aspects of the game, as well as adds many convenient features and chips in the game. The collection is designed to play on a free private server in minecraft “Mushrooms”.
That would get to us join our discord and apply for membership. 12+

Our Discord: https://discord.gg/S6qYYf8htE
![we](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/026309266519a62e8b738b45efd24802bdda71dc_0.webp)
Author of some resource packs used in the build:
[Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/organization/fabulously-optimized),
[Minimal Armor](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/minimal-armor-countxd/version/2WjguvnV)
